name: Propaganda — "can't attack you unless their controller pays {2}" is a trait naming both players
notes: Conor's decision 2026-10-13: rules about attacking, blocking and being targeted are traits (never ability lines), in the words of the card with the players filled in; Goaded is a trait only and names the player who goaded. Parser block 'Rules about attacking, blocking and being targeted' in cards-parser.js, _resolveTraitText in engine-helpers.js. "You" is Propaganda's controller, "their controller" the creature's. The rule says nothing about the creatures of the player it protects, so those get no trait.

traits: Can't attack Player 1 unless Opponent pays {2} for each creature Opponent controls that is attacking Player 1

$excludes: Can't attack Player 1 unless Player 1 pays {2} for each creature Player 1 controls that is attacking Player 1
